title: अंश १ · अध्याय १४

items.text:
पृथोः पुत्रौ महावीर्यौ जज्ञातोऽन्तर्द्धिपालिनौ
शिखण्डिनी हविर्द्धानमन्तर्द्धानाद् व्यजायत ॥ १ ॥
items.tr:
pṛthoḥ putrau mahāvīryau jajñāto'ntarddhipālinau
śikhaṇḍinī havirddhānamantarddhānād vyajāyata || 1 ||

items.text:
हविर्द्धानात् षडाग्नेयी धिषणाजनयत् सुतान् ।
प्राचीनबर्हिषं शुक्रं गयं कृष्णं व्रजाजिनौ ॥ २ ॥
items.tr:
havirddhānāt ṣaḍāgneyī dhiṣaṇājanayat sutān |
prācīnabarhiṣaṃ śukraṃ gayaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vrajājinau || 2 ||

items.text:
प्राचीनबर्हिर्भगवान् महानासीत् प्रजापतिः ।
हविर्धानान्महाभाग येन संवर्धिताः प्रजाः ॥ ३ ॥
items.tr:
prācīnabarhirbhagavān mahānāsīt prajāpatiḥ |
havirdhānānmahābhāga yena saṃvardhitāḥ prajāḥ || 3 ||

items.text:
प्राचीनाग्राः कुशास्तस्य पृथिव्यां विश्रुता मुने ।
प्राचीनबर्हिरभवत्ख्यातो भुवि महाबलः ॥ ४ ॥
items.tr:
prācīnāgrāḥ kuśāstasya pṛthivyāṃ viśrutā mune |
prācīnabarhirabhavatkhyāto bhuvi mahābalaḥ || 4 ||

items.text:
समुद्रतनयायां तु कृतदारो महीपतिः ।
महतस्तमसः पारे सवर्णायां महामते ॥ ५ ॥
items.tr:
samudratanayāyāṃ tu kṛtadāro mahīpatiḥ |
mahatastamasaḥ pāre savarṇāyāṃ mahāmate || 5 ||

items.text:
सवर्णाधत्त सामुद्री दश प्राचीनबर्हिषः ।
सर्वे प्राचेतसो नाम धनुर्वेदस्य पारगाः ॥ ६ ॥
items.tr:
savarṇādhatta sāmudrī daśa prācīnabarhiṣaḥ |
sarve prācetaso nāma dhanurvedasya pāragāḥ || 6 ||

items.text:
अपृथग्धर्मचरणास्ते तप्यन्त महत्तपः ।
दशवर्षसहस्राणि समुद्रसलिलेशयः ॥ ७ ॥
items.tr:
apṛthagdharmacaraṇāste tapyanta mahattapaḥ |
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi samudrasalileśayaḥ || 7 ||

items.speaker: श्रीमैत्रेय उवाच
items.text:
यदर्थं ते महात्मानस्तपस्तेपुर्महामुने ।
प्राचेतसः समुद्राम्भस्येतदाख्यातुमर्हसि ॥ ८ ॥
items.tr:
yadarthaṃ te mahātmānastapastepurmahāmune |
prācetasaḥ samudrāmbhasyetadākhyātumarhasi || 8 ||

items.speaker: श्रीपराशर उवाच
items.text:
पित्रा प्रचेतसः प्रोक्ताः प्रजार्थममितात्मना ।
प्रजापतिनियुक्तेन बहुमानपुरःसरम् ॥ ९ ॥
items.tr:
pitrā pracetasaḥ proktāḥ prajārthamamitātmanā |
prajāpatiniyuktena bahumānapuraḥsaram || 9 ||

items.text:
ब्रह्मणा देवदेवेन समादिष्टोस्म्यहं सुताः ।
प्रजाः संवर्धनीयास्ते मया चोक्तं तथेति तत् ॥ १० ॥
items.tr:
brahmaṇā devadevena samādiṣṭosmyahaṃ sutāḥ |
prajāḥ saṃvardhanīyāste mayā coktaṃ tatheti tat || 10 ||
items.speaker: प्राचीनबर्हिरुवाच

items.text:
तन्मम प्रीतये पुत्राः प्रजावृद्धिमतन्द्रिताः ।
कुरुध्वं माननीया वः सम्यगाज्ञा प्रजापतेः ॥ ११ ॥
items.tr:
tanmama prītaye putrāḥ prajāvṛddhimatandritāḥ |
kurudhvaṃ mānanīyā vaḥ samyagājñā prajāpateḥ || 11 ||

items.speaker: श्रीपराशर उवाच
items.text:
ततस्ते तत्पितुः श्रुत्वा वचनं नृपनन्दनाः ।
तथेत्युक्त्वा च तं भूयः पप्रच्छुः पितरं मुने ॥ १२ ॥
items.tr:
tataste tatpituḥ śrutvā vacanaṃ nṛpanandanāḥ |
tathetyuktvā ca taṃ bhūyaḥ papracchuḥ pitaraṃ mune || 12 ||

items.speaker: प्रचेतस ऊचुः
items.text:
येन तात प्रजावृद्धौ समर्था कर्मणा वयम् ।
भवेम तत्समस्तं नः कर्म व्याख्यातुमर्हसि ॥ १३ ॥
items.tr:
yena tāta prajāvṛddhau samarthā karmaṇā vayam |
bhavema tatsamastaṃ naḥ karma vyākhyātumarhasi || 13 ||

items.text:
पितोवाच
आराध्य वरदं विष्णुमिष्टप्राप्तिमसंशयम् ।
समेति नान्यथा मर्त्यः किमन्यत्कथयामि वः ॥ १४ ॥
items.tr:
pitovāca
ārādhya varadaṃ viṣṇumiṣṭaprāptimasaṃśayam |
sameti nānyathā martyaḥ kimanyatkathayāmi vaḥ || 14 ||

items.text:
तस्मात्प्रजा विवृद्ध्यर्थं सर्वभूतप्रभुं हरिम् ।
आराधयत गोविन्दं यदि सिद्धिमभीप्सथः ॥ १५ ॥
items.tr:
tasmātprajā vivṛddhyarthaṃ sarvabhūtaprabhuṃ harim |
ārādhayata govindaṃ yadi siddhimabhīpsathaḥ || 15 ||

items.text:
धर्ममर्थं च कामं च मोक्षं चान्विच्छतां सदा ।
आराधनीयो भगवाननादिपुरुषोत्तमः ॥ १६ ॥
items.tr:
dharmamarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca mokṣaṃ cānvicchatāṃ sadā |
ārādhanīyo bhagavānanādipuruṣottamaḥ || 16 ||

items.text:
यस्मिन्नाराधिते सर्गं चकारादौ प्रजापतिः ।
तमाराध्याच्युतं वृद्धिः प्रजानां वो भविष्यति ॥ १७ ॥
items.tr:
yasminnārādhite sargaṃ cakārādau prajāpatiḥ |
tamārādhyācyutaṃ vṛddhiḥ prajānāṃ vo bhaviṣyati || 17 ||

items.speaker: श्रीपराशर उवाच
items.text:
इत्येवमुक्तास्ते पित्रा पुत्राः प्राचेतसो दश ।
मग्नाः पयोधिसलिले तपस्तेषुः समाहिताः ॥ १८ ॥
items.tr:
ityevamuktāste pitrā putrāḥ prācetaso daśa |
magnāḥ payodhisalile tapasteṣuḥ samāhitāḥ || 18 ||

items.text:
दशवर्षसहस्राणि न्यस्तचित्ता जगत्पतौ ।
नारायणे मुनिश्रेष्ठ सर्वलोकपरायणे ॥ १९ ॥
items.tr:
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi nyastacittā jagatpatau |
nārāyaṇe muniśreṣṭha sarvalokaparāyaṇe || 19 ||

items.text:
तत्रैवावस्थिता देवमेकाग्रमनसो हरिम् ।
तुष्टुवुर्यःस्तुतः कामान् स्तोतुरिष्टान्प्रयच्छति ॥ २० ॥
items.tr:
tatraivāvasthitā devamekāgramanaso harim |
tuṣṭuvuryaḥstutaḥ kāmān stoturiṣṭānprayacchati || 20 ||

items.speaker: श्रीमैत्रेय उवाच
items.text:
स्तवं प्रचेतसो विष्णोः समुद्राम्भसि संस्थिताः ।
चक्रुस्तन्मे मुनिश्रेष्ठ सुपुण्यं वक्तुमर्हसि ॥ २१ ॥
items.tr:
stavaṃ pracetaso viṣṇoḥ samudrāmbhasi saṃsthitāḥ |
cakrustanme muniśreṣṭha supuṇyaṃ vaktumarhasi || 21 ||

items.speaker: श्रीपराशर उवाच
items.text:
शृणु मैत्रेय गोविन्दं यथापूर्वं प्रचेतसः ।
तुष्टुवुस्तन्मयीभूताः समुद्रसलिलेशयाः ॥ २२ ॥
items.tr:
śṛṇu maitreya govindaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ pracetasaḥ |
tuṣṭuvustanmayībhūtāḥ samudrasalileśayāḥ || 22 ||

items.speaker: प्रचेतस ऊचुः
items.text:
नताः स्म सर्ववचसां प्रतिष्ठा यत्र शाश्वती ।
तमाद्यन्तमशेषस्य जगतः परमं प्रभुम् ॥ २३ ॥
items.tr:
natāḥ sma sarvavacasāṃ pratiṣṭhā yatra śāśvatī |
tamādyantamaśeṣasya jagataḥ paramaṃ prabhum || 23 ||

items.text:
ज्योतिराद्यमनौपम्यमण्वनन्तमपारवत् ।
योनिभूतमशेषस्य स्थावरस्य चरस्य च ॥ २४ ॥
items.tr:
jyotirādyamanaupamyamaṇvanantamapāravat |
yonibhūtamaśeṣasya sthāvarasya carasya ca || 24 ||

items.text:
यस्याहः प्रथमं रूपमरूपस्य तथा निशा ।
संध्या च परमेशस्य तस्मै कालात्मने नमः ॥ २५ ॥
items.tr:
yasyāhaḥ prathamaṃ rūpamarūpasya tathā niśā |
saṃdhyā ca parameśasya tasmai kālātmane namaḥ || 25 ||

items.text:
भुज्यतेऽनुदिनं देवैः पितृभिश्च सुधात्मकः ।
बीजभूतं समस्तस्य तस्मै सोमात्मने नमः ॥ २६ ॥
items.tr:
bhujyate'nudinaṃ devaiḥ pitṛbhiśca sudhātmakaḥ |
bījabhūtaṃ samastasya tasmai somātmane namaḥ || 26 ||

items.text:
यस्तमास्यत्ति तीव्रात्मा प्रभाभिर्भासयन्नभः ।
घर्मशीताम्भसा योनिस्तस्मै सूर्यत्मने नमः ॥ २७ ॥
items.tr:
yastamāsyatti tīvrātmā prabhābhirbhāsayannabhaḥ |
gharmaśītāmbhasā yonistasmai sūryatmane namaḥ || 27 ||

items.text:
काठिन्यवान् यो बिभर्ति जगदेतदशेषतः ।
शब्दादिसंश्रयो व्यापी तस्मै भूम्यात्मने नमः ॥ २८ ॥
items.tr:
kāṭhinyavān yo bibharti jagadetadaśeṣataḥ |
śabdādisaṃśrayo vyāpī tasmai bhūmyātmane namaḥ || 28 ||

items.text:
यद्योनिभूतं जगतो वीजं यत्सर्वदेहिनाम् ।
तत्तोयरूपमीशस्य नमामो हरिमेधसः ॥ २९ ॥
items.tr:
yadyonibhūtaṃ jagato vījaṃ yatsarvadehinām |
tattoyarūpamīśasya namāmo harimedhasaḥ || 29 ||

items.text:
यो मुखं सर्वदेवानां हव्यभुक्कव्यभुक्तथा ।
पितॄणां च नमस्तस्मै विष्णवे पावकात्मने ॥ ३० ॥
items.tr:
yo mukhaṃ sarvadevānāṃ havyabhukkavyabhuktathā |
pitṝṇāṃ ca namastasmai viṣṇave pāvakātmane || 30 ||

items.text:
पञ्चधावस्थितो देहे यश्चेष्टां कुरुतेऽनिशम् ।
आकाशयोनिर्भगवांस्तस्मै वाय्वात्मने नमः ॥ ३१ ॥
items.tr:
pañcadhāvasthito dehe yaśceṣṭāṃ kurute'niśam |
ākāśayonirbhagavāṃstasmai vāyvātmane namaḥ || 31 ||

items.text:
अवकाशमशेषाणां भूतानां यः प्रयच्छति ।
अनन्तमूर्तिमाञ्छुद्धस्तस्मै व्योमात्मने नमः ॥ ३२ ॥
items.tr:
avakāśamaśeṣāṇāṃ bhūtānāṃ yaḥ prayacchati |
anantamūrtimāñchuddhastasmai vyomātmane namaḥ || 32 ||

items.text:
समस्तेन्द्रियसर्गस्य यः सदा स्थानमुत्तमम् ।
तस्मै शब्दादिरूपाय नमः कृष्णाय वेधसे ॥ ३३ ॥
items.tr:
samastendriyasargasya yaḥ sadā sthānamuttamam |
tasmai śabdādirūpāya namaḥ kṛṣṇāya vedhase || 33 ||

items.text:
गृह्णाति विषयान्नित्यमिन्द्रियात्माक्षराक्षरः ।
यस्तस्मै ज्ञानमूलाय नतास्म हरिमेधसे ॥ ३४ ॥
items.tr:
gṛhṇāti viṣayānnityamindriyātmākṣarākṣaraḥ |
yastasmai jñānamūlāya natāsma harimedhase || 34 ||

items.text:
गृहीतानिन्द्रियैरर्थानात्मने यः प्रयच्छति ।
अन्तःकरणरूपाय तस्मै विश्वात्मने नमः ॥ ३५ ॥
items.tr:
gṛhītānindriyairarthānātmane yaḥ prayacchati |
antaḥkaraṇarūpāya tasmai viśvātmane namaḥ || 35 ||

items.text:
यस्मिन्ननन्ते सकलं विश्वं यस्मात्तथोद्गतम् ।
लयस्थानं च यस्तस्मै नमः प्रकृतिधर्मिणे ॥ ३६ ॥
items.tr:
yasminnanante sakalaṃ viśvaṃ yasmāttathodgatam |
layasthānaṃ ca yastasmai namaḥ prakṛtidharmiṇe || 36 ||

items.text:
शुद्धः संल्लक्ष्यते भ्रान्त्या गुणवानिव योऽगुणः ।
तमात्मरूपिणं देव नतास्म पुरुषोत्तमम् ॥ ३७ ॥
items.tr:
śuddhaḥ saṃllakṣyate bhrāntyā guṇavāniva yo'guṇaḥ |
tamātmarūpiṇaṃ deva natāsma puruṣottamam || 37 ||

items.text:
अविकारमजं शुद्धं निर्गुणं यन्निरजनम् ।
नताःस्मतत्परं ब्रह्म विष्णोर्यत्परमं पदम् ॥ ३८ ॥
items.tr:
avikāramajaṃ śuddhaṃ nirguṇaṃ yannirajanam |
natāḥsmatatparaṃ brahma viṣṇoryatparamaṃ padam || 38 ||

items.text:
अदीर्घह्रस्वमस्थूलण्वनमश्यामलोहितम् ।
अस्नेहच्छायमतनुमसक्तमशरीरीणम् ॥ ३९ ॥
items.tr:
adīrghahrasvamasthūlaṇvanamaśyāmalohitam |
asnehacchāyamatanumasaktamaśarīrīṇam || 39 ||

items.text:
अनाकाशमसंस्पर्शमगन्धमरसं च यत् ।
अचक्षुश्रोत्रमचलमवाक्पाणिममानिसम् ॥ ४० ॥
items.tr:
anākāśamasaṃsparśamagandhamarasaṃ ca yat |
acakṣuśrotramacalamavākpāṇimamānisam || 40 ||

items.text:
अनामगोमत्रसुखमतेजस्कमहेतुकम् ।
अभयं भ्रान्तिरहितम निद्रमजरामरम् ॥ ४१ ॥
items.tr:
anāmagomatrasukhamatejaskamahetukam |
abhayaṃ bhrāntirahitama nidramajarāmaram || 41 ||

items.text:
अरजोशब्दममृतमप्लुतं यदसंवृतम् ।
पूर्वापरेण वै यस्मिस्तद्विष्णोः परमं पदम् ॥ ४२ ॥
items.tr:
arajośabdamamṛtamaplutaṃ yadasaṃvṛtam |
pūrvāpareṇa vai yasmistadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam || 42 ||

items.text:
परमेशत्वगुणवत्सर्वभूतमसंशयम् ।
नतास्म तत्पदं विष्णोर्जिह्वादृग्गोचरं न यत् ॥ ४३ ॥
items.tr:
parameśatvaguṇavatsarvabhūtamasaṃśayam |
natāsma tatpadaṃ viṣṇorjihvādṛggocaraṃ na yat || 43 ||

items.speaker: श्रीपराशर उवाच
items.text:
एवं प्रचेतसो विष्णुं स्तुवन्तस्तत्समाधयः ।
दशवर्षसहस्राणि तपश्चेरुर्महार्णवे ॥ ४४ ॥
items.tr:
evaṃ pracetaso viṣṇuṃ stuvantastatsamādhayaḥ |
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi tapaścerurmahārṇave || 44 ||

items.text:
ततः प्रसन्नो भगवांस्तेषामन्तर्जले हरिः ।
ददौ दर्शनमुन्निद्रनीलोत्पलदलच्छविः ॥ ४५ ॥
items.tr:
tataḥ prasanno bhagavāṃsteṣāmantarjale hariḥ |
dadau darśanamunnidranīlotpaladalacchaviḥ || 45 ||

items.text:
पतत्रिराजमारूढमवलोक्य प्रचेतसः ।
प्रणिपेतुः शिरोभिस्तं भक्तिभारावनामितैः ॥ ४६ ॥
items.tr:
patatrirājamārūḍhamavalokya pracetasaḥ |
praṇipetuḥ śirobhistaṃ bhaktibhārāvanāmitaiḥ || 46 ||

items.text:
ततस्तानाह भगवान्व्रयतामीप्सतो वरः ।
प्रसादसुमुखोहं वो वरदः समुपस्थितः ॥ ४७ ॥
items.tr:
tatastānāha bhagavānvrayatāmīpsato varaḥ |
prasādasumukhohaṃ vo varadaḥ samupasthitaḥ || 47 ||

items.text:
ततस्तमूचुर्वरदं प्रणिपत्य प्रचेतसः ।
यथा पित्रा समादिष्टं प्रजानां वृद्धिकारणम् ॥ ४८ ॥
items.tr:
tatastamūcurvaradaṃ praṇipatya pracetasaḥ |
yathā pitrā samādiṣṭaṃ prajānāṃ vṛddhikāraṇam || 48 ||

items.text:
स चापि देवस्तं दत्त्वा यथभिलषितं वरम् ।
अन्तर्धानं जगामाशु ते च निश्चक्रमुर्जलात् ॥ ४९ ॥
items.tr:
sa cāpi devastaṃ dattvā yathabhilaṣitaṃ varam |
antardhānaṃ jagāmāśu te ca niścakramurjalāt || 49 ||

items.h: इति श्रीविष्णुपुराणे प्रथमेऽंशे प्रचेतास्तवो नाम चतुर्दशोऽध्यायः (१४)

en_chapter: From Prithu were born two highly powerful sons named Antardhāna and Pāli. And Antardhāna begot on Shiknandini a son named Habirdhāna. And Habirdhāna again begot on Dhishana six sons—named, Prāchinberhis, Sukra, Gaya, Krishna, Braja and Ajina. Prāchinverhis was a mighty prince and patriarch by whom mankind was multiplied after the death of Havirdhāna. He was called Prāchinverhis on account of his placing upon the earth (at the time of his prayer) the sacred grass pointing to the east. After a protracted devotion that lord of earth married the daughter of the Ocean named Savaranā. And Prāchinverhis, begot on Savaranā, the daughter of the Ocean ten sons, who were all called Prachetas and were all well-skilled in archery. They all practised the same religious austerities and remained immersed in the bed of the deep for ten thousand years. Maitreya said,—"Do thou, O great ascetic, tell me, why those high-souled Prachetas practised austerities being immersed in the deep". Parāçara said,—Welcoming the high-souled Prāchinverhis, the Patriarch requested him to multiply race. And he accordingly addressed his sons, saying,—"O my sons, I have been commanded by Bramhā, the god of gods to multiply mankind. And I too had promised obedience. Do ye therefore, my sons, diligently promote the increase of mankind. You shall all with reverence obey the commands of the Patriarch". Parāçara said,—Hearing the words of their father those princes said, "So be it" and repeatedly addressed him, O Muni, saying,—"By what, O father, we shall be able to multiply mankind? It behoveth thee to mention this unto me". The father said,—"There is no doubt that people shall meet with an accomplishment of all their desires, if they worship Vishnu, the conferrer of boons. There is no other alternative. What future can I tell you? If you wish to succeed, do you adore Govinda who is Hari, the lord of all beings, in order to bring about the increase of mankind. The excellent Purusha, without beginning, should be worshipped by him who wishes for virtue, wealth, enjoyment or liberation. Adore him, who is imperishable and propitiating whom the great Patriarch Brahmā succeeded in creating the universe". Parāçara said,—Being thus addressed by their father the ten Prachetas plunged into the deep and with concentrated minds, engaged in devotion. O foremost of ascetics, with their minds wholly devoted to Nārāyana, the refuge of all creatures and the lord of the universe, and withdrawing their thoughts from all other exterior objects, they remained (in the state of devotion) for ten thousand years. And remaining there they worshipped with concentrated minds that great God Hari, who, when propitiated, confers, on all those who praise him, whatever they desire. Maitreya said,—"O foremost of ascetics, the praises addressed to Vishnu, by those Prachatas, lying plunged in the depths of the ocean are sacred and it behoveth thee to relate them unto me". Parāçara said—Do thou hear—(I shall recount) the praises addressed, of old, to Govinda by the Prachetas as they stood in the waters of the deep. Prachetas said,—"We bow unto him who is the eternal theme of all speech, who is the beginning of the boundless universe and the lord of it; who is the primeval light—who has not the like of him; indivisible and infinite; who is the creator of all things, mobile and immobile—salutation unto him, who is one with time, who is without form—and whose first form is the day and the second and third form are the evening and night. Salutation unto him, who is the same with the moon who is the life of all living beings, and who is the receptacle of ambrosia, drunk daily by the celestials and progenitors. Salutation unto him, who is one with the sun, who with his fierce rays, dispels darkness from the sky and who is the creator of the seasons—the summer, the winter and the rains. Salutation unto him, who is one with the earth—who, being solid, is supporting the whole universe and is the asylum of smell and all other objects of sense. We bow to that form of Hari, which is water, which is the seed of all living beings and the womb of the world. Salutation unto Vishnu, who is one with Fire, who is the mouth of the celestials being the eater of the Havya and who is the mouth of the progenitors being the eater of the Kavya. Salutation unto him who is at one with the air, which exists as five vital airs in the body causing constant vital action and is the origin of ether. Salutation unto him, who is at one with the atmosphere, who is pure, whose form and end cannot be perceived, who is shapeless and limitless and who gives separate existence to all creatures. Salutation unto Krishna, who is the creator, is perceived in the form of sensible objects and is the direction of the faculties of sense. We bow unto Hari, who is one with senses both subtle and substantial, who receives the impression of the senses, and who is the source of all knowledge. Salutation unto that universal soul, who as intellect carries the impressions received by the senses to the soul—Salutation unto him who is Prakriti—who has created the Universe, who is maintaining it and in whom it shall perish. We bow unto that excellent Purusha, who albeit freed from all and devoid of all qualities, appears, to the creatures labouring under mistakes, as enveloped with all qualities. Salutation unto that Brahmā, who is the ultimate condition of Vishnu, who is unchangeable, without birth, pure, void of qualities and free from accidents; who is neither high nor low neither massive nor thin, has neither shape, nor colour, nor shadow, nor substance nor affection nor body; who is neither ethereal nor capable of being touched; who is neither smell nor taste; who has no eyes, cars, or motion or speech, breath mind; who is without name, gotra, countenance or lustre; who is without fear or mistake; without blame, disease or death; who is free from passion, without sins, imperceptible, inactive, independent of place and time, separated from all investing properties, but exercising irresistible might, and who is at one with all beings and dependant upon none. Salutation to that nature of Vishnu which tongue cannot describe nor eye hath seen". Parāçara said—Thus glorifying Vishnu the Prachetas performed austerities for ten thousand years in the depths of the sea. Thereupon Hari, having the complexion of the full-blown lotus leaf, being pleased, appeared before them even in the midst of waters. And beholding him mounted on Garuda, the Prachetas bending low their heads with reverence, saluted him. Thereupon Vishnu addressed them, saying,—"Do you ask of me a boon. Being pleased with you I have come here to confer boons on you". Bowing unto that giver of boons, the Prachetas asked of him the multiplication of mankind as ordered by their parents. And granting them the wished for boon Vishnu disappeared instantly and Prachetas too came out of the sea.
